name: PhotoPrism
short_description: AI-Powered Photos App for organizing and sharing your collection on the Decentralized Web.
description: PhotoPrism is an AI-powered app for browsing, organizing, and sharing your photo collection. It makes use of the latest technologies to tag and find pictures automatically without getting in your way. Say goodbye to the endless scrolling and let PhotoPrism's AI find the best shots.
usecases: Share albums with friends and family.
